json.error:
No Figma plugin is connected to the bridge. A Figma plugin tried to connect <N>s ago and was REJECTED: it brought a different bridge token, so Figma is running a plugin copy install.mjs did not produce (typically this repository's figma-plugin/ imported directly, or a copy from an older install).

HINT: the user fixes it once: Figma → Plugins → Development → Import plugin from manifest… → <root>\figma-plugin\manifest.json, then remove the old entry (named "Antigravity Bridge" before 4.3.0, or a duplicate "Mokido"). Do NOT write the token into ui.html or any other source file — it would leak into the repository.
